Benchmark runs used think=True and returned thinking text. A local tag without a prefix is normalized to ollama: and matches this pattern
Benchmark runs (12b and 31b) used think=True and returned thinking text. Check /api/show when changing the tag
The gpt-5 default is medium, and some variants do not reason unless asked, so the effort is always sent
gpt-4o is not a reasoning model; reasoning arguments may be rejected
4.6 enables thinking only with adaptive. display defaults to summarized but is set explicitly because later generations default to omitted
The Sonnet 5 family defaults display to omitted, so summarized must be set for thinking to be recorded. effort=high matches the other models
Gemini 3 reasons dynamically by default (3.x=HIGH). Passing thinking_budget would override the vendor default, so only summaries are enabled
The vendor default thinking level of 3.5-flash is medium, so high is set explicitly to match effort=high of the other models. Gemini 3+ takes thinking_level (=reasoning_effort), not thinking_budget
